files.source: Euro foreign exchange reference rates of the European Central Bank (ecb.europa.eu, eurofxref-hist.zip) (ECB series: EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.MXN.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.BRL.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.ZAR.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.KRW.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.INR.EUR.SP00.A). Modified data: the values in this file are U.S.-dollar cross rates computed by the organizers from the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (MXN, BRL, ZAR, KRW, INR: units of currency per U.S. dollar, computed as CCY-per-EUR / USD-per-EUR), in full float64 precision without rounding; the ECB does not publish these cross rates. Source: ECB
